description: This file contains functions for formatting and representing matrices and sparse matrices, including default string representations and printing functions, as part of the CVXOPT library.

methods.name: matrix_str_default
methods.description: Returns a formatted string representation of a matrix X with configurable width and height.

methods.name: matrix_repr_default
methods.description: Returns a brief string description of a matrix X.

methods.name: spmatrix_str_default
methods.description: Returns a formatted string representation of a sparse matrix X.

methods.name: spmatrix_str_triplet
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a sparse matrix in triplet form.

methods.name: spmatrix_repr_default
methods.description: Returns a brief string description of a sparse matrix X.
